sections.title: We're here to help
sections.content: If you have a question about Hold, ran into a bug, or need help with your subscription, reach out and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.

sections.title: Contact Us
sections.content: Send us an email and we'll respond within 1–2 business days.

sections.title: Subscription Help
sections.content: Hold subscriptions are billed through your Apple ID. To cancel or manage your subscription:
list: On iPhone or iPad: Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions.
